question: With the controller-facing latent (R38), does semantic supervision on the transmitted packet improve new-body transfer/adaptation (and packet semantics) relative to a capacity-matched latent without semantic objectives, the action-only codec and direct actions, at <=25% p95 latency overhead?

methods.baseline_direct_action: old FlowPolicy latent_dim=1 + hidden-state auxiliaries (configs/model/policy-small-structured.json, packed data) — native ActionChunk path
methods.baseline_action_only_codec: old action-only codec (configs/model/codec-small.json) + FlowPolicy on codec latent — native ActionChunk path

latency.condition: no other GPU lease active on the peer

dev_rule: development iteration only on source bodies and dev scenes (>=3,000,000); targets/eval scenes untouched until the sealed runs
notes: latent representation (encoder+realizer+probes) is frozen per variant before any flow/adaptation comparison; GRPO later optimizes the stochastic latent policy with the realizer and latent meaning frozen.
